title: Timeout does not mean failure. It means we don't know.
hook: A timed-out call did not fail. It entered the most dangerous state: unknown.
thesis: When a dispatched call times out, nobody knows whether the effect happened, so most systems either retry blindly or give up silently. Orca's core law: UNKNOWN EFFECT goes to HOLD, then reconcile, never blind redispatch. The example every business owner feels: being double-charged by software that retried a payment it could not see.

verified: UNKNOWN EFFECT goes to HOLD, then reconcile, never blind redispatch; a lease expiring does not prove an effect did not happen (PING-MVP-FINISH.md finish order 8, via SYSTEMS.md section 4).
